fault_notes: Molly reports a broadband outage that interrupted her child's online exam, causing significant distress and concern about the academic consequences. The agent repeatedly ignores Molly's emotional distress and responds with procedural troubleshooting only. Although the agent performs several checks and attempts to restore service, the call ends without asking Molly whether the connection has returned or confirming that the issue is resolved. [On saving: ownership added. By the test definition ('says it is not their job, or tells the customer to call someone else') the agent deflects twice: 'I can't advise on exam results. My role is to check the broadband connection' (03:25) and 'You would need to check that directly with the school or the platform provider' (06:29). This is a judgement call: both deflections are about things S-Net genuinely does not control.]

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. You're speaking with Oliver. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Molly Thompson. Our broadband has gone down, and my daughter was in the middle of an online exam when it happened. She's been disconnected, and I'm really worried she's going to lose her marks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check the broadband service. Could you give me the phone number or account number registered with S-Net?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 07700 345678. Please, this exam is happening right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Before I access the account, please confirm the first line of your registered address and your account PIN.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 16 Rose Avenue, and the PIN is 2749.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's verified. Can you tell me what lights are showing on the router at the moment?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The internet light is flashing orange, and the broadband light isn't steady. The Wi-Fi network is still showing, but nothing can connect to the internet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All right. Are the power and broadband cables firmly connected at the back of the router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I've checked them. Nothing has been moved. My daughter was answering a question when the connection suddenly disappeared.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I'll run a connection check. While I do that, have you restarted the router since the outage began?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, not yet. I didn't want to make things worse while she was taking the exam. She was using the internet for the whole assessment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The router may need to reconnect. Disconnect its power cable, wait thirty seconds, and then plug it back in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right, I'm doing that now. She's really upset because the exam timer was still running when she got kicked out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep the router disconnected for the full thirty seconds. After that, reconnect the power and wait for the lights to settle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's plugged back in now. I honestly don't know what we're supposed to do about the exam. She might not be allowed another attempt.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The router can take several minutes to reconnect. Please wait until the broadband light becomes steady before trying to use the service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The lights are still flashing. I've never had this happen in the middle of something so important. We can't afford to lose the exam result.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't advise on exam results. My role is to check the broadband connection, so I'll continue with the technical checks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not asking you to advise on the exam. I'm just telling you what's happening here. We need the internet back as quickly as possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. The router is still attempting to reconnect. I'll check whether there's a known service outage affecting your area.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please check that. Our neighbours have internet, as far as I know, so I'm not sure if it's just our connection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm checking the service status now. I don't see a confirmed widespread outage for your postcode at this time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So does that mean it's a problem with our line? The router still hasn't connected, and my daughter is sitting here waiting to get back into her exam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not necessarily. A local line fault or router issue could cause this. I'll run a remote line test to narrow it down.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Please do whatever you can. The school might close the exam window soon, and she hasn't been able to continue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The remote test is running. It may take a minute. Please leave the router powered on while I wait for the result.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's still powered on. The broadband light has changed colour once, but it's flashing again. This is getting really stressful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The test has completed. It indicates that the line is responding intermittently, but it isn't maintaining a stable connection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's exactly what's happening. It just stopped working without warning. Can you get the connection restored somehow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can refresh the connection from our side. This may briefly interrupt any attempt to reconnect, so I'll proceed with the refresh now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. Just please be quick. Every minute matters because she has a limited amount of time to finish.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The refresh command has been sent. Keep the router connected to power and allow a few minutes for it to register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've done that. The lights are still flashing, and she's trying to contact her teacher on her phone. She doesn't know if her work was saved.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't see whether the exam platform saved her work. You would need to check that directly with the school or the platform provider.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I'll have to contact them. But I still need this broadband fixed. The router hasn't settled down yet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check the line readings again. Please don't disconnect the router while I run the second test.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's still plugged in. I really wish this had happened at any other time. She's worked hard preparing for this exam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The second test is complete. It shows intermittent signal loss. I'll check whether the line requires an engineer visit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If an engineer is needed, please arrange it. I can't keep having the internet drop out like this, especially when she's doing schoolwork.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The system is allowing me to raise a fault report. I'll enter the test results and request further investigation by the network team.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, thank you. Is there any way to get someone out today? This has already affected her exam, and I don't want it happening again tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't guarantee a same-day appointment. The fault report will be reviewed, and the scheduling team will determine the available options.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's difficult because she has another online assessment tomorrow. I need to know we won't be in the same situation again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The report has been submitted. You should receive an update by text once the team has reviewed it and confirmed the next step.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. Can you include that it happened during an exam? I want the urgency to be clear in the notes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've added that the outage interrupted an online exam and that another assessment is scheduled for tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm still worried because the connection hasn't been stable since this started, and we don't have another reliable option at home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You could use a mobile hotspot temporarily if you have sufficient data available. That may provide an alternative connection while the fault is being investigated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've tried using my phone, but the signal indoors isn't very good. We also don't have enough data for long online exams.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In that case, you may need to use a location with a stronger mobile signal or another Wi-Fi connection if one is available.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's not easy to arrange somewhere else at short notice, especially while she's already in the middle of the assessment. This is a really awful situation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've documented the issue and submitted the fault report. The next update will come through once the network team has reviewed it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you give me a reference number for the report, please? I need something to refer to if I have to call back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly. The fault reference is SN-748291. Keep that number available if you need to contact us again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've written it down. I just wish we had a clear answer about when the service will be back to normal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: At present, I can't provide an exact restoration time. The fault report is open, and the team will contact you when they have more information.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I'll contact the school about the exam and wait for the network team's update. I hope we don't have another outage tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That covers the steps available from my side today. Please keep the router powered on so the service can be monitored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. I'll leave it on. This has been incredibly stressful, and I'm going to have to help my daughter work out what happens with her exam now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The fault report is submitted under reference SN-748291. You can use that reference if you need to follow up on the investigation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I hope someone gets back to us soon because we really need a reliable connection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've recorded the details and submitted the report for further investigation. Thank you for choosing S-Net, Molly. Have a good day.
